---
title: "Pseudomask Quality Analysis"
subtitle: "Plant Disease Segmentation --- Binary vs MC115 pipeline comparison"
format: beamer
---

```{python}
#| echo: false

from pathlib import Path
import json
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
from IPython.display import Markdown, display

ANALYSIS_ROOT = Path("../resources/mask_quality_binary_plantseg")

methods = {}
for p in sorted(ANALYSIS_ROOT.glob("*_summary.json")):
    with open(p) as f:
        s = json.load(f)
    methods[s["label"]] = s

method_labels = list(methods.keys())
```

## Pipeline comparison: Binary vs MC115 (2-class eval)

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output-location: slide

rows = [
    {"Pipeline": "Binary",  "Stage": "LA-CRF",  "mIoU": "45.01%", "BG IoU": "77.37%", "Disease IoU": "12.64%"},
    {"Pipeline": "MC115",   "Stage": "LA-CRF",  "mIoU": "51.94%", "BG IoU": "76.10%", "Disease IoU": "27.77%"},
    {"Pipeline": "Binary",  "Stage": "HA-CRF",  "mIoU": "45.44%", "BG IoU": "76.52%", "Disease IoU": "14.36%"},
    {"Pipeline": "MC115",   "Stage": "HA-CRF",  "mIoU": "53.49%", "BG IoU": "75.81%", "Disease IoU": "31.16%"},
    {"Pipeline": "Binary",  "Stage": "PSA+RW",  "mIoU": "43.01%", "BG IoU": "65.80%", "Disease IoU": "20.21%"},
    {"Pipeline": "MC115",   "Stage": "PSA+RW",  "mIoU": "42.29%", "BG IoU": "54.17%", "Disease IoU": "30.42%"},
    {"Pipeline": "Binary",  "Stage": "WeakCLIP","mIoU": "46.22%", "BG IoU": "66.93%", "Disease IoU": "25.52%"},
    {"Pipeline": "MC115",   "Stage": "WeakCLIP","mIoU": "46.36%", "BG IoU": "59.40%", "Disease IoU": "33.31%"},
]

pdf = pd.DataFrame(rows)
display(Markdown(pdf.to_markdown(index=False)))
display(Markdown(
    r"""
**MC115 hypothesis confirmed:** multiclass (115 disease) MCTformer produces
more localized CAM activations. Disease IoU improves at every stage
(e.g.\ WeakCLIP: 25.52% $\to$ 33.31%, $+$31% relative). Background IoU
drops due to increased recall, with overall mIoU comparable or better.
"""
))
```

## Sparsity summary

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output-location: slide

rows = []
for label, s in methods.items():
    rows.append({
        "Method": label,
        "Mean GT fg%": f"{s['mean_gt_fg_frac']:.1%}",
        "Median GT fg%": f"{s['median_gt_fg_frac']:.1%}",
        "Mean Pred fg%": f"{s['mean_pred_fg_frac']:.1%}",
        "Median Pred fg%": f"{s['median_pred_fg_frac']:.1%}",
        "Pred/GT ratio": f"{s['mean_pred_fg_frac']/max(s['mean_gt_fg_frac'],1e-9):.2f}x",
    })

display(Markdown(pd.DataFrame(rows).to_markdown(index=False)))
```

Key: Pred/GT ratio > 1 means systematic oversegmentation.

## IoU distribution

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Per-image foreground IoU distribution"
#| output-location: slide

colors = ["#2176AE", "#D7263D", "#57A773", "#F49D37"]
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 4))
for i, label in enumerate(method_labels):
    csv_path = ANALYSIS_ROOT / f"{label.replace('/', '_').replace(' ', '_')}_per_image.csv"
    if csv_path.exists():
        df = pd.read_csv(csv_path)
        ax.hist(df["iou"], bins=50, alpha=0.55, label=label,
                color=colors[i % len(colors)], edgecolor="white", linewidth=0.5)
ax.set_xlabel("Per-image foreground IoU")
ax.set_ylabel("Count")
ax.legend()
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

---

## GT sparsity vs Pred sparsity

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Points above the diagonal = oversegmentation"
#| output-location: slide

colors = ["#2176AE", "#D7263D", "#57A773", "#F49D37"]
n = len(method_labels)
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, n, figsize=(5*n, 4.5), squeeze=False)
for i, label in enumerate(method_labels):
    csv_path = ANALYSIS_ROOT / f"{label.replace('/', '_').replace(' ', '_')}_per_image.csv"
    ax = axes[0, i]
    if csv_path.exists():
        df = pd.read_csv(csv_path)
        ax.scatter(df["gt_fg_frac"], df["pred_fg_frac"],
                   s=4, alpha=0.3, color=colors[i % len(colors)], rasterized=True)
        lim = max(df["gt_fg_frac"].max(), df["pred_fg_frac"].max()) * 1.05
        ax.plot([0, lim], [0, lim], "k--", alpha=0.4, linewidth=1)
        ax.set_xlim(0, lim); ax.set_ylim(0, lim)
        ax.set_aspect("equal")
    ax.set_xlabel("GT fg fraction")
    ax.set_ylabel("Pred fg fraction")
    ax.set_title(label)
    ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

---

## Oversegmentation vs Undersegmentation

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Each point is one image. Mean shown with dashed lines."
#| output-location: slide

colors = ["#2176AE", "#D7263D", "#57A773", "#F49D37"]
n = len(method_labels)
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, n, figsize=(5*n, 4.5), squeeze=False)
for i, label in enumerate(method_labels):
    csv_path = ANALYSIS_ROOT / f"{label.replace('/', '_').replace(' ', '_')}_per_image.csv"
    ax = axes[0, i]
    if csv_path.exists():
        df = pd.read_csv(csv_path)
        ax.scatter(df["overseg_ratio"], df["underseg_ratio"],
                   s=4, alpha=0.3, color=colors[i % len(colors)], rasterized=True)
        mo = df["overseg_ratio"].mean()
        mu = df["underseg_ratio"].mean()
        ax.axvline(mo, color="red", ls="--", alpha=0.6, label=f"mean overseg={mo:.2f}")
        ax.axhline(mu, color="blue", ls="--", alpha=0.6, label=f"mean underseg={mu:.2f}")
        ax.legend(fontsize=7, loc="upper right")
    ax.set_xlabel("Overseg ratio (FP / pred)")
    ax.set_ylabel("Underseg ratio (FN / GT)")
    ax.set_title(label)
    ax.set_xlim(-0.02, 1.02); ax.set_ylim(-0.02, 1.02)
    ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## IoU vs GT sparsity

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Colored by oversegmentation ratio (red = high overseg)"
#| output-location: slide

n = len(method_labels)
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, n, figsize=(5*n, 4.5), squeeze=False)
for i, label in enumerate(method_labels):
    csv_path = ANALYSIS_ROOT / f"{label.replace('/', '_').replace(' ', '_')}_per_image.csv"
    ax = axes[0, i]
    if csv_path.exists():
        df = pd.read_csv(csv_path)
        sc = ax.scatter(df["gt_fg_frac"], df["iou"],
                        c=df["overseg_ratio"], cmap="RdYlGn_r",
                        s=4, alpha=0.4, vmin=0, vmax=1, rasterized=True)
        fig.colorbar(sc, ax=ax, label="Overseg ratio", shrink=0.8)
    ax.set_xlabel("GT fg fraction")
    ax.set_ylabel("IoU")
    ax.set_title(label)
    ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## Per-disease breakdown (worst + best)

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output-location: slide

for label in method_labels:
    safe = label.replace("/", "_").replace(" ", "_")
    csv_path = ANALYSIS_ROOT / f"{safe}_per_disease.csv"
    if not csv_path.exists():
        continue
    ddf = pd.read_csv(csv_path)
    worst5 = ddf.head(5)[["disease", "count", "mean_iou", "mean_overseg", "mean_underseg"]].copy()
    best5 = ddf.tail(5)[["disease", "count", "mean_iou", "mean_overseg", "mean_underseg"]].copy()
    worst5["mean_iou"] = worst5["mean_iou"].map(lambda x: f"{x*100:.1f}%")
    best5["mean_iou"] = best5["mean_iou"].map(lambda x: f"{x*100:.1f}%")
    worst5["mean_overseg"] = worst5["mean_overseg"].map(lambda x: f"{x:.2f}")
    best5["mean_overseg"] = best5["mean_overseg"].map(lambda x: f"{x:.2f}")
    worst5["mean_underseg"] = worst5["mean_underseg"].map(lambda x: f"{x:.2f}")
    best5["mean_underseg"] = best5["mean_underseg"].map(lambda x: f"{x:.2f}")
    display(Markdown(f"**{label} -- worst 5 diseases:**"))
    display(Markdown(worst5.to_markdown(index=False)))
    display(Markdown(f"\n**{label} -- best 5 diseases:**"))
    display(Markdown(best5.to_markdown(index=False)))
```

## Takeaways

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output-location: slide

binary = {k: v for k, v in methods.items() if k.startswith("Binary")}
mc115 = {k: v for k, v in methods.items() if k.startswith("MC115")}

lines = ["**Binary vs MC115 comparison (per-image disease IoU):**\n"]
for bkey, mkey in [("Binary PSA+RW", "MC115 PSA+RW"), ("Binary WeakCLIP", "MC115 WeakCLIP")]:
    if bkey in methods and mkey in methods:
        b, m = methods[bkey], methods[mkey]
        delta_iou = m["mIoU"] - b["mIoU"]
        lines.append(f"**{bkey.split()[-1]}**: disease IoU {b['mIoU']:.1f}% → {m['mIoU']:.1f}% "
                     f"(+{delta_iou:.1f}pp)")
        lines.append(f"  - Recall: {b['mean_recall']:.3f} → {m['mean_recall']:.3f}, "
                     f"Underseg: {b['mean_underseg_ratio']:.3f} → {m['mean_underseg_ratio']:.3f}")
display(Markdown("\n".join(lines)))

display(Markdown(
    r"""
**Key finding:** MC115 multiclass training dramatically improves disease
detection (recall $+$0.3 for PSA+RW, $+$0.09 for WeakCLIP) and reduces
undersegmentation. The remaining bottleneck is oversegmentation
(overseg $\approx$ 0.62), suggesting that mask refinement (SAM with
``smallest\_area`` selection) could still help at this stage.
"""
))
```
